Project Title: Attention-Based Multi-Step Forecasting and License Plate Recognition
Project Description:
2. Multi-Step Time Series Forecasting: Implement an Encoder-Decoder LSTM with Attention and residual forecasting to predict transformer oil temperature (OT) for the next five consecutive hours, using the previous 48 hours of ETTh1 oil temperature and six electrical load variables.

3. License Plate Recognition: Develop a spatial CNN Encoder with a GRU Decoder and visual Attention to recognize complete seven-character Chinese plates from annotation-derived crops in a fixed 50,000-image CCPD-Base cohort.
